roundup.title: June 2026 — finance & energy signals for hospitality
paragraphs: This edition is a working shell: section cards mirror Music News so Vincent can grow a proper market & funding round-up. Headlines below are pulled from the shared Greenways news catalogue (same pipeline as Cheryce) and framed for payback, grants, and loans — not retail tariff advice.
Wholesale hubs on Finance wire remain the live price skim. Use this page when you want the slower, story-led view: policy moves, funding windows, and what they mean for equipment upgrades.
Images are placeholders for now. When you have Wix stills for markets, kitchens, or programme campaigns, drop URLs into meta.heroImages and optional pick.image fields.
